==== /.src/catchTagToCatchReasonRootChains.ts (0 errors) ====
    // @effect-diagnostics *:off
    // @effect-diagnostics catchTagToCatchReason:suggestion
    import { Effect as Fx } from "effect"
    
    class ReasonA {
      readonly _tag = "ReasonA"
    }
    
    class ReasonB {
      readonly _tag = "ReasonB"
      constructor(readonly detail: string) {}
    }
    
    class OuterError {
      readonly _tag = "OuterError"
      constructor(
        readonly reason: ReasonA | ReasonB,
        readonly context: string
      ) {}
    }
    
    declare const program: Fx.Effect<number, OuterError>
    declare function loadOuterError(): OuterError
    
    // Should NOT trigger: the second branch dispatches on the wrapper's own _tag,
    // so the branches do not share the exact error.reason._tag discriminant even
    // though every access is rooted at the handler parameter.
    export const mixedSameRootChains = program.pipe(
      Fx.catchTag("OuterError", (error) => {
        if (error.reason._tag === "ReasonA") return Fx.succeed(1)
        if (error._tag === "OuterError") return Fx.succeed(2)
        return Fx.fail(error)
      })
    )
    
    // Should NOT trigger: a call-rooted chain is not anchored to the handler
    // parameter, even though the accessed type carries the same _tag union.
    export const callRootedChain = program.pipe(
      Fx.catchTag("OuterError", (error) => {
        if (loadOuterError().reason._tag === "ReasonA") return Fx.succeed(1)
        return Fx.fail(error)
      })
    )
